summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new 'Créer un TagPoint' screen (onglet '+') and POST /api/tag-points endpoint. Backend: 41/41 tests pass. Frontend: all form sections, interactions, and API integration verified working correctly.

minor.issue: The 'images' and 'tag_ids' fields are returned as JSON strings ('[]') instead of proper JSON arrays ([]) due to double JSON encoding: json.dumps() called in Python before asyncpg JSONB codec also encodes. In tagpoint_routes.py line 544-545: json.dumps(data.tag_ids) and json.dumps(data.images or []) produce strings that asyncpg re-encodes as JSONB strings.
minor.fix: Pass Python lists directly to asyncpg (without json.dumps): data.tag_ids and data.images or [] — let the JSONB type codec (set in _init_connection) handle encoding.

images_string_bug.bug: POST /api/tag-points returns images as string '[]' instead of array []
images_string_bug.root_cause: database.py sets asyncpg JSONB type codec with encoder=json.dumps. tagpoint_routes.py line 545 also calls json.dumps() before passing to asyncpg. Result: Python list [] -> json.dumps -> '[]' (string) -> asyncpg JSONB encoder -> '"[]"' (JSON string stored as JSONB). When read back: JSONB decoder -> '[]' (Python string, not list).
images_string_bug.fix: In tagpoint_routes.py, replace json.dumps(data.images or []) with (data.images or []) and json.dumps(data.tag_ids) with data.tag_ids — let the asyncpg JSONB codec handle encoding.
